title: Data on Care Staff to Residents Ratio in Local Nursing Homes
what_it_is: Data on Care Staff to Residents Ratio in Local Nursing Homes

sections.label: Nursing home manpower and pay
sections.summary: MOH and AIC attract and train community care workers and recruit foreign nurses, while compensation is reviewed regularly with no specific announcement now.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, many healthcare institutions, including nursing homes, face a tight manpower situation, as healthcare workers are in great demand throughout the world.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) works with the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) to attract jobseekers into the community care sector, including nursing homes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: They also work closely with nursing homes to develop healthcare workers professionally.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This includes the Community Care Traineeship Programme for their newly-hired local healthcare and therapy assistants; and providing subsidies through AIC-appointed Learning Institutes for a range of developmental and skills training programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In addition, we are stepping up efforts to recruit foreign nurses to work in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Are there any plans to bring local Intermediate and Long-term Care (ILTC) staff's pay and benefits up to, at least, the level of the restructured hospitals, so that they can better attract and retain local staff?

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We do regularly review the compensation for all the healthcare workers in all the sectors, as well as whether there is a significant variance across the norms.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I do not have any specific announcements about plans to review at this point in time, but it is an ongoing work.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We will update the House at appropriate junctures.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I do not have the data for compliance rates amongst the different providers in the long-term care sector.

sections.label: Acute care sector recruitment needs
sections.summary: The passage states there are needs in the acute care sector and that the answer is to increase overall recruitment into both sectors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We do also have needs within the acute care sector as well.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, the real answer is to increase the overall recruitment and bring people into both sectors.
